# Workflow step and run errors

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @openverify/api workflow-docs:write`: edit the code, not this file. -->

A run stores a code, never a value. `message` is set only for configuration and input errors, and never holds what was refused; anything a step produced stays sealed in its output (C120.2). The types are an open set: a client must read an unknown one as `unknown-error`. A code that is not listed reads `unknown-error`, and a Slack error is `slack_<code>` with the code Slack published.

## Flow action steps

An `action` step of an inquiry template’s flow (C152) that fails takes its `error` edge with one of these codes, recorded on the step record; `run_workflow` also puts it in the flow’s scope as `workflows.<step id>.error-type`, with the outputs `null`. `workflow_grant_widened` means the target version’s grant or egress grew past what the template’s publish recorded: no run starts until the template is republished. A timed-out run is canceled; a step already executing when the cancel lands still finishes.

| Code | Type |
|---|---|
| `account_fields_invalid` | invalid-input-error |
| `account_missing` | missing-input-error |
| `account_redacted` | resource-error |
| `action_not_entered` | unknown-error |
| `field_unknown` | configuration-error |
| `field_write_once` | invalid-input-error |
| `fields_too_large` | invalid-input-error |
| `inquiry_not_open` | resource-error |
| `run_canceled` | resource-error |
| `run_errored` | resource-error |
| `run_missing` | resource-error |
| `scope_unavailable` | missing-input-error |
| `timeout` | resource-error |
| `verification_not_decided` | missing-input-error |
| `workflow_grant_widened` | configuration-error |
| `workflow_not_found` | configuration-error |
| `workflow_not_published` | configuration-error |
| `workflow_not_running` | configuration-error |

## Definitions

A `definition_invalid` problem holds `errors[] { pointer, code, detail }`, each a JSON Pointer into the definition. A problem never echoes a received value.

- **Structure:** `trigger_missing`, `module_input_missing`, `start_repeated`, `output_missing`, `edge_endpoint_unknown`, `edge_port_unknown`, `port_repeated`, `port_unconnected`, `node_unreachable`, `output_unreachable`, `cycle_refused`, `continue_port_invalid`, `join_missing`, `join_repeated`, `join_of_invalid`, `branch_not_joined`, `branch_leaves`, `branch_entered`, `loop_body_open`, `loop_body_escapes`, `loop_body_entered`, `map_output_missing`, `map_of_invalid`, `loop_concurrency_refused`, `nesting_too_deep`.
- **Modules and actions:** `module_nested`, `module_refused_for_trigger`, `module_unknown`, `module_input_unknown`, `module_variables_refused`, `action_unknown`, `action_trigger_refused`, `action_requires_inquiry`, `action_refused_in_loop`, `config_invalid`, `config_too_large`, `retry_refused`, `literal_member_refused`.
- **Declarations:** `type_invalid`, `variable_default_invalid`, `variable_unknown`, `variable_read_only`, `parallel_variable_conflict`, `output_mapping_missing`, `output_mapping_unknown`.
- **Conditions:** `condition_malformed`, `operator_refused`, `operator_arity`, `operator_argument`, `var_default_refused`, `path_invalid`, `path_unknown`, `path_untyped`, `current_case_unavailable`, `type_incomparable`, `expression_limit_exceeded`, `pii_literal_in_condition`, `nullable_in_boolean_position`, `on_null_missing`, `on_null_route_unknown`, `secret_placement_refused`.
- **Loops and waits:** `loop_items_invalid`, `wait_subject_invalid`.
- **Templates and URLs:** `template_invalid`, `template_too_large`, `url_invalid`, `url_host_not_literal`, `url_scheme_refused`, `url_credentials_refused`, `url_position_refused`.
- **Publish:** `schedule_invalid`, `schedule_zone_invalid`, `schedule_never_fires`, `pii_into_plain_sink`, `pii_in_url`, `has_match_refused`, `account_count_refused`, `reference_unknown`, `decision_basis_missing`, `contest_route_missing`, `contest_route_host_refused`, `biometric_basis_missing`, `recipient_not_allowed`, `rollout_refused_for_module`, `rollout_without_control`, `rollout_trigger_changed`.
- **Warnings, which never block publish:** `variable_unused`, `output_unread`, `trigger_self_emitted`, `read_without_companion`, `approve_without_evidence`, `provider_not_configured`, `signal_not_exposed`, `child_workflow_unpublished`, `child_grant_widened`, `publisher_scope_lost`.

## Why nothing started

These are `reason-code`s of a row, never a run’s error.

- **A trigger delivery:** `workflow_not_running`, `event_before_activation`, `event_not_listened`, `subject_redacted`, `definition_unreadable`, `payload_too_large`, `criteria_not_met`, `criteria_null`, `criteria_invalid`, `verification_type_not_listed`, `subject_filter_not_met`, `trigger_depth_exceeded`, `trigger_cycle`, `trigger_cause_missing`, `trigger_fanout_exceeded`, `event_missing`, `event_retention_passed`.
- **A scheduled run:** `workflow_not_running`, `workflow_trigger_mismatch`, `run_depth_exceeded`, `run_grant_insufficient`, `source_run_missing`, `definition_unreadable`, `trigger_input_invalid`, `subject_redacted`, `workflow_archived`.
- **A manual run, by object:** `object_id_invalid`, `object_repeated`, `object_not_found`, `subject_redacted`, `payload_too_large`, `rate_limited`.
